original_question: Let disc(A) = inf_{x in {+1,-1}^n} ||Ax||_infinity for A in {+1,-1}^{n x n}. What is the exact value of sup_{n in N} sup_{A in {+1,-1}^{n x n}} (1/sqrt(n)) * disc(A)?
target_in_paper: Entry 6, Open Problem 11 (How many deviations are needed afterall?)
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper's actual target almost exactly: it uses the same discrepancy functional disc(A) = inf_{x∈{±1}^n} ||Ax||_∞, the same class of matrices A ∈ {±1}^{n×n}, and the same normalized extremal quantity (1/√n) disc(A) whose exact supremum is asked for in Open Problem 11.
missing_details: State explicitly that n is a positive integer.
State explicitly that A is an n×n sign matrix, i.e. every entry of A lies in {±1}.
State explicitly that x ranges over {±1}^n, so the optimization variable has the same dimension as the number of columns of A.
Specify that ||·||_∞ is the standard ℓ∞-norm on R^n.
Clarify that the problem asks for the exact supremum over all finite dimensions n, not an asymptotic limsup; the nearby Conjecture 12 is only a weaker asymptotic statement.

If you want the question to be fully paper-faithful in context, note that this is the square ±1-matrix Spencer setting, not the broader Komlós setting of arbitrary matrices with unit ℓ2-normalized columns.
refined_question:
For each positive integer n and each sign matrix A ∈ {±1}^{n×n}, define its discrepancy by disc(A) := min_{x∈{±1}^n} ||Ax||_∞, where ||·||_∞ is the usual ℓ∞-norm on R^n. What is the exact value of the extremal normalized discrepancy
sup_{n∈N} sup_{A∈{±1}^{n×n}} disc(A)/√n ?
justification: The draft is essentially a restatement of Open Problem 11 in Entry 6. On page 8, the paper first defines disc(A) for an n×n matrix A and then asks exactly for the value of sup_{n∈N} sup_{A∈{±1}^{n×n}} (1/√n) disc(A). The surrounding discussion frames this as a lower-bound question for Spencer's theorem in the square sign-matrix setting. The nearby Conjecture 12 is not equivalent to Open Problem 11; it is a weaker asymptotic claim asserting only that lim sup_{n→∞} sup_{A∈{±1}^{n×n}} disc(A)/√n > 1. Conjecture 13 is a specific Hadamard-matrix route that the paper says would settle Conjecture 12, but it is likewise not the same as the exact-value problem in Open Problem 11.
